verdict.rationale: Pulley documents an 83(b) Election status tracker among its cap table tools, and its compliance product claims to handle "tax filings" alongside ASC 718 reporting. Neither Rule 701 disclosure-threshold tracking nor Form 3921 generation is named anywhere, and nothing shows filings being generated automatically from the cap table. Missing for 10: explicit Rule 701 threshold monitoring, Form 3921 generation, evidence of automated filing generation from cap table data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
